column1: # THE DURABLE RECORD OF EVERY ROUTED INTERRUPT. Append-only, one row per
# interrupt, tab separated. Read by tools/blocking-count.py, which prints
# Blocking pushes per week. Classes and routing: production/interrupt-classes.md
# NO SPACES IN ANY VALUE. Every reader of this file splits on whitespace at
# some point; use / and .. and - for structure. A subject is a slug.
# date        ISO, the day the interrupt was ROUTED (not the day it arose)
#             the last two record a Producer-versus-resident disagreement
#             about the class, which Jafar ruled a health metric
# link        a GitHub or console URL, or - when there is none yet
# THIS FILE HAS NO ROWS AS IT IS WRITTEN, 2026-09-03. That is why the counter
# prints the words nothing measured rather than 0: nobody has routed an
# interrupt through it yet, and a 0 here would claim a quiet week that was
